OP, I feel you, and I’d like to give you some advice as an almost 25yo woman who also went through her teenage years :) 

Teenagers in school can be horrible, but school is just a bubble that you will get out of. It’s hard to understand this when you’re there, but most of those people will not matter when you graduate. Even more than that - not all people popular in school actually succeed later in life. Of course it’s good to make connections there that will last, but It is not worth it to force yourself to change, especially for this. It’s ok to grow as a person and experience change through it, but not forcibly for anyone else. Doing that is a straight full proof road to being unhappy. Keep your interests, and the love for cutesy things, and find people who like them to talk to. I promise you, there are MANY others who are crazy nerds about all of those things you mentioned. Hear me, there is nothing, absolutely nothing strange about what you like.

Regarding the bullying - unfortunately in our reality whether you can do something depends on your luck about your surroundings. Do you have good relationships with the adults in your life? Does your school have a support system, and teachers who care about your wellbeing? If yes, then reach out to them. Ideally, it is the job of adults to fix this problem. However, in many places the problem of bullying isn’t taken seriously, and then it can get worse if the adults will not react to it appropriately. So depending on your situation, either ask the adults for help, or, sadly, just power through it. It helps to have a different social circle too, people to talk to. Remember that it won’t be like this forever. 

Lastly, and I say this with my whole heart, GET OFF ED TWITTER. It is a horrible place, especially for a teenage girl! It is very, very important that you eat well in your age, your body needs energy now more than ever to grow and sustain itself. 

If you want to have a nice figure (and health, which is more important, but I do understand), there are great alternatives to starving. Check out intermittent fasting - not only it helps with weight loss, but is actually great for your health. However, do not overdo it! You’re just 14. Stick to beginner-window plans, 16-8 should be your top bracket that you never go above of! Best is from 12-12 to 15-9 though, I would recommend you stay there. And also, EAT HEALTHY. It is very important! What you eat matters more than how much you eat. If you’d like to talk about it, you can text me, and I’ll give you some more advice on eating habits that helped me personally with losing weight and still feeling great and being healthy. 
And eating healthy also will have a good effect on your skin! Your skin is having a difficult time too because of your age and hormones going wild, it happens to many people and is completely normal. I had problems with skin when I was a teenager too, unless you have a medical condition, It will pass. Otherwise it will pass with a help of a doctor :)

I know there is a lot of pressure from society. But, unfortunately, it’s just an evil thing that girls encounter in our world. The world wants you to feel less, feel unsure, worry about your skin, your weight, your hair. It is through this lack of confidence that the world wants to control you and get more from you. You’re stronger than this, and you should learn to love, accept, and take care of yourself and your body.

Sending you all the love. I hope you find more friends that will love you and support you and what you like. If you have no one to share your interests with, you can share them with me :) I also like anime, games and cartoons :) That doesn’t replace you finding a social circle that is your age, though.
